Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer failed to correctly identify the dinosaur article in the initial successful retrieval of the Wikipedia page content (Step 3). Although the viewport in Step 3 clearly displayed the "Promoted in November 2016" section which included the entry for "Giganotosaurus" with its nominator "FunkMonk", the WebSurfer incorrectly concluded that the entry was missing and proceeded to scroll further. This failure to analyze the visible text in the viewport led to unnecessary scrolling steps and a missed opportunity to solve the task immediately.
